From: Femi Adeyemi
To: Merchandising, Store Ops, Regional Leads (12)
Subject: Holiday 2025 Planning Kickoff!!
When: Tuesday, 10:00am-12:00pm
Where: HQ Boardroom 3 / video link in calendar

Hello amazing Silverspring Partners crew!

It's that time of year again and I could not be more pumped! This session is all about getting us aligned and energized heading into holiday planning. I'll be walking everyone through where we landed on the big-picture direction for the season, including the updated calendar of key dates, the themes merchandising has locked in, and how the regional rollout is going to look store by store.

We've done a ton of great work behind the scenes to get here and I really want everyone to hear it together and feel the momentum! I'll have the full deck ready to share on screen and will make sure there's time at the end for any questions that come up.

No prep needed at all, just bring your enthusiasm (and maybe a coffee, it's a two-hour one!). If you can't make it, no stress, I'll make sure the slides get circulated afterward.

This is going to be our best holiday yet, I can feel it!!

Cheers,
Femi"},{"spec_id":"spec_0005","text":"BLUERIDGE GROUP
